entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • API for fetching Cache Line size for current CPU architecture #131703
  • Value enumerators do not account for being constructed via `default`, unexpectedly throwing `NullReferenceException`. #131702
  • [ci-scan-feedback] Guard fixer against retired-leg / already-fixed help-wanted PRs #131699
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Fixer reported incomplete result #131698
  • [Feature Request]: CoreCLR GC cache topology awareness for Hybrid CPUs (P/E-Cores) and upcoming bLLC architectures (Intel Nova Lake) #131695
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Fixer failed #131689

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: Add X86 and ARM hardware intrinsics for RDRAND/RDSEED/RNDR/RNDRRS and AMX/SME/APX #131694
  • JIT: opportunistically lower `value & ((1 << k) - 1)` to BMI2 BZHI #129368
    Future
  • [ci-scan] BinaryFormatterTests.ValidateAgainstBlobs blob mismatch (WebSocketException format change) #129981
  • [JIT] Questions & suggestions regarding escape analysis and heap allocation analyzers #131676
  • Test failure: System.IO.Tests.StreamReader_StringCtorTests.NegativeOneBufferSize_ShouldNotThrowException #128019
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove temporary array allocations in `ComVariant.As`. #131704
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, community-contribution
  • Support unsafe evolution in ComInterface, ComClass, JSImport, JSExport and VtableIndexStub generators #131701
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices
  • Fix haiku and illumos x64 builds #131700
    area-Infrastructure, os-SunOS, community-contribution, os-haiku
  • Reduce false sharing in MemoryCache #131696
    area-Extensions-Caching
  • [cDAC] Implement IXCLRDataValue APIs #131690
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • JIT: elide redundant wasm Virtual IP updates #131688
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr

Merged

  • Support unsafe evolution in LibraryImportGenerator #131245
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, linkable-framework, source-generator, reduce-unsafe
  • Fix cDAC DBI cleanup lifetime #131627
    area-Diagnostics-cdac
  • Adopt issue-labeler v2.2.0 in runtime workflows #131685
    area-Infrastructure
  • Exclude WebSocketException from BinaryFormatter blob ToString comparison #131682
    area-Serialization

Updated

  • [wasm] Emit webcil payloadSize/tableSize into boot config for streaming instantiation #131658
    arch-wasm, area-Host, 11.0.0
  • Validate experimental Helix queues #131589
    area-Infrastructure
  • Fix profiler ReJIT of Runtime Async method bodies #131681
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, runtime-async, 11.0.0
  • [wasm][R2R] Create manifest token when type reference wasn't pre-registered #131651
    arch-wasm, area-crossgen2-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 3036708 #130641
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Add reproZero NativeAOT compiler project #131686
    wasm-aot-test, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Recognize bit-manipulation idioms and emit bzhi/bts/btc/btr/bt on xarch #130481
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, Priority:2
  • Remove calli target tagging from CoreCLR interop stubs #131642
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Fix Environment.GetCommandLineArgs()[0] to report the host invocation name #131671
    area-Host, community-contribution
  • Implement convertPInvokeCalliToCall for CoreCLR #131654
    area-VM-coreclr
  • JIT: Strip redundant shift-count mask earlier in gtFoldExprBinary #131660
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix configuration binder dropping collection items with null constructor parameters #131455
    area-Extensions-Configuration, 11.0.0
  • Build vararg support only where it is reachable #131655
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Emit a resolvable type name for Runtime Async continuations in GC heap dumps #131684
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #131569
    area-codeflow
  • Improve JIT false-positive review guidance #131673
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
